summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow for CipherBox phase 68.2 (SDK-owned read chain and resolved folder listings) end-to-end — research, scope resolution, requirements registration, planning, and verification — then hand off to execute-phase to implement the resulting plans.
summary.outcome: Phase 68.2 was fully planned: RESEARCH.md, VALIDATION.md, and PATTERNS.md were produced, a D-07 scope ambiguity was resolved by the user (full boundary), REQUIREMENTS.md gained SDK-READ-01..04, the planner emitted 12 plans across 7 waves, and the plan-checker returned PASSED (2 non-blocking warnings, logged as a todo). Execute-phase then started, choosing sequential execution on the main tree over parallel worktrees, and began Wave 1 (plan 68.2-01).

repo: GSD commit helper can report `commit_failed` as a false negative even when the commit actually succeeded via lint-staged — always verify with `git log` before treating it as a real failure.
The intel API-SURFACE extraction (§7.9) returns 0 symbols for this monorepo — it's HINT-only, so omit it from planner prompts rather than passing empty noise.
gsd-tools gap-analysis output can contain control characters in its `rendered` field that break naive parsing — run the underlying check directly instead of parsing the wrapped output.

D-07's literal wording ('no raw IPFS/IPNS access anywhere in apps/web/src') sweeps in off-path pockets not covered by the phase's stated success criteria: BYO-pinning settings (ConnectionTest.tsx, StorageTab.tsx) and auth-bootstrap/device-registry crypto (useAuth.ts, device-registry.service.ts) — worth an explicit scope decision rather than assuming SC#1-5 define the full boundary.

In this pnpm monorepo, worktree executors need their own `pnpm install` per worktree, which is expensive; when most waves are single-plan, sequential execution on the main tree is preferable to parallel worktree spin-up/merge/cleanup.

Before dispatching executors into parallel worktrees, verify `worktree.baseRef` — if it defaults to `origin/main` ('fresh') instead of live HEAD, executors would fork missing any HEAD-only commits (e.g., freshly committed PLAN.md files).

code.finding: Wave 1 plan adds the ROT-07 anti-rollback gate (RotationHighWater.enforceResolved) to the SDK's own read path (resolvePublishedNode/dfsFindFolder/ensureFolderLoaded) via TDD (RED gate test → GREEN implementation), and must land before any deletion of ipns.service.ts so no shipped security guarantee regresses (RESEARCH Pitfall 2).

workflow: In plan-phase, the UI plan-gate only actually fires if the registry's `when` condition activates a UI capability hook for the phase — a lower-level ui-plan-gate check reporting `block:true` is irrelevant if no UI hook is active in `activeHooks`.
Register new requirement IDs (e.g., SDK-READ-01..04) in REQUIREMENTS.md before spawning the planner, so coverage gates have a stable target to check against.
Plan-checker warnings are advisory and non-blocking — proceed to finalization but log a gap-closure todo matching the repo's `.planning/todos/pending/` dated-markdown convention.
In execute-phase, check both the worktree base-check (#683 auto-degrade decision) and `worktree.baseRef` before choosing parallel-worktree vs sequential execution mode.

Auto-advance config (`auto_advance: true`) should still be confirmed with the user via AskUserQuestion when the next step is a large, security-critical, multi-wave execution with outstanding checker warnings, rather than silently launching.

friction: GSD commit helper's `commit_failed` false-positive required manual `git log` verification at least twice during the session.
gap-analysis.plan-post check output had control characters that broke the standard parser, requiring a direct re-run of the check.
intel API-SURFACE extraction came back empty (0 symbols), adding a dead-end step before it could be skipped.
D-07's grep-gate scope was ambiguous and required a mid-flow AskUserQuestion to resolve before planning could proceed confidently.
Nyquist validation setup created a hard dependency on RESEARCH.md's Validation Architecture section, forcing research to run before VALIDATION.md could be populated.
open_items: D-03's poll-invalidation leg has no dedicated automated test (only call-site grep coverage in Plan 09) — logged as todo `.planning/todos/pending/2026-07-06-d03-poll-invalidation-lacks-automated-coverage.md` for a future gap-closure pass.
Execution of the 12-plan, 7-wave phase 68.2 is only at Wave 1 (plan 68.2-01 dispatched) — Waves 2-7 remain to be executed.
Write-share key threading (SHARE-WRITE-KEY) remains an open gap per prior project memory, tangential to but not resolved by this phase's SDK read-chain work.
